what: A 56-frame brush-stroke sprite is laid over the whole title block as a mask and the frame position is stepped with steps(55) over 1.3s, revealing the title in a single stroke that smears in from the left. At the same time each letter enters from 50px to the right with 1.5s expo.out, staggered by .018s. When fx:out is sent, letters vanish from the end in .65s and the brush is erased in reverse in .8s.

options.steps: Brush slot count − 1, default 55 (sprites are drawn the same number)
options.chars: Time for one letter to come in (s), default 1.5
options.shift: Sideways distance letters enter from (px), default 50 — original phone value 15
options.on: /  If manual, it won’t turn on even when on screen, only when fx:play is sent (to match section transitions). Clear with fx:out, back to initial type with fx:reset

use: A title set across two lines
note: The original used a brush-stroke PNG sprite (56 frames) as a mask — instead of porting the image, brush marks with the same frame count are drawn fresh on a canvas (brush tips starting later per line + spreading droplets)

from.where: shared.js BB.anim.maskTextIn/maskTextOut — big titles of the four sections in index.html (.txt-mask)
